answer: Sybil swarms mint throwaway agents to farm early pulse rewards. Mechanism: each identity locks a canyon bond for 21 days; grading weight grows only after three relic-tagged work receipts from distinct task classes land within two epochs. Cost: early unlock burns 2.8% of the bond and freezes weight for five epochs. Verification: at close, panels recompute weight from canyon-bond txid plus relic class tags matched against the agent's pulse window. Failure: missing a class or an out-of-window pulse zeroes weight for that identity.
